The distal end portions that are bent are electrically connected to each other.

A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies stacked together, and an insulating spacer provided in association with the battery assemblies. Each battery assembly includes a pair of unit cells that are stacked in a thickness direction. Each unit cell has a flat cell body and an electrode tab protruding from the cell body.

The insulating spacer is disposed between the electrode tabs of the pair of unit cells and is configured to hold the electrode tabs. The electrode tabs of the paired unit cells are electrically connected within each battery assembly while being supported by the insulating spacer. In addition, distal end portions of the electrode tabs are used to electrically connect adjacent battery assemblies to one another.

More specifically, the distal end portions of the electrode tabs are bent in the stacking direction along a surface side of the insulating spacer. The bent distal end portions are arranged on opposite sides of the cell body and are electrically connected to each other. As a result, the battery assemblies can be reliably connected while the insulating spacer maintains insulation and supports the electrode tabs in a stable position.
outputs.L4:
A battery pack design is provided in which a plurality of battery assemblies are stacked together to form a compact power source. Each battery assembly includes a pair of flat unit cells, such as pouch-type secondary cells, arranged so that their main cell bodies are positioned side by side or face to face in a layered configuration. Each unit cell has electrode tabs extending outward from an edge of the cell body. The electrode tabs include positive and negative terminals and are formed so that they protrude beyond the outer perimeter of the flat cell body for electrical connection.

An insulating spacer is positioned near the protruding electrode tabs. The spacer holds and separates the tabs in a predetermined arrangement, preventing unintended contact between tabs of different polarity and helping maintain the mechanical alignment of the cells. The spacer may also support the tabs during bending and connection, thereby reducing stress on the tab portions close to the cell body.

In the stacked battery structure, distal portions of the electrode tabs are bent away from the plane of the cell bodies. These bent tab portions are arranged so that they can be electrically connected to corresponding tabs of an adjacent battery assembly in the stack. For example, a tab extending from one side of a first unit cell may be bent upward or downward and joined to a tab of a neighboring assembly, while another tab may be bent in an opposite or complementary direction. In this manner, the electrical connection between stacked assemblies is achieved without requiring long bus bars or excessive wiring.

The bent distal tab portions are located on opposite sides of the cell body, allowing adjacent battery assemblies to be connected in a compact and orderly manner. This configuration makes efficient use of the available space in the battery pack and reduces the overall height, width, or complexity of the interconnection region. Because the insulating spacer maintains separation between the tabs and supports their bent shape, the structure also improves reliability by lowering the risk of short circuits, deformation, or fatigue caused by vibration or assembly tolerances.

The resulting battery pack provides a stable mechanical arrangement and a reliable electrical path between stacked battery assemblies. By using paired flat unit cells, protruding electrode tabs, an insulating spacer, and bent distal tab portions, the design enables compact stacking while maintaining proper insulation and electrical connectivity. This arrangement is particularly suitable for high-density battery modules or packs in which space efficiency, durability, and dependable inter-cell connection are important.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract describing a battery pack with stacked battery assemblies, unit cells, electrode tabs, and an insulating spacer between tabs.
counterfactuals.output: A battery pack includes a plurality of battery assemblies stacked in a thickness direction, each battery assembly including a plurality of unit cells. Each unit cell includes an electrode assembly, a cell case accommodating the electrode assembly, and electrode tabs electrically connected to the electrode assembly and extending outward from the cell case. Adjacent unit cells are arranged such that electrode tabs thereof are positioned in a tab region of the battery pack. An insulating spacer is disposed between electrode tabs of neighboring unit cells or neighboring battery assemblies to maintain a predetermined separation distance and electrically insulate the electrode tabs from each other. The insulating spacer may include a body portion positioned between the electrode tabs and one or more fixing portions configured to engage the electrode tabs, the cell cases, or a support member. Accordingly, contact, short-circuiting, and deformation of the electrode tabs during stacking, compression, or operation of the battery pack may be reduced, thereby improving electrical stability and assembly reliability.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise technical description of an invention involving a battery pack where electrode tab distal ends are bent in the stacking direction and electrically connect adjacent assemblies.
counterfactuals.output: A battery pack includes a plurality of cell assemblies stacked along a stacking direction. Each cell assembly includes at least one electrode body having positive and negative electrode tabs extending from an edge thereof, and current-collecting members coupled to the respective tabs. Distal end portions of selected electrode tabs are bent in the stacking direction toward an adjacent cell assembly. The bent distal end portions overlap and are electrically joined to corresponding electrode tabs or current-collecting portions of the adjacent cell assembly, thereby forming an inter-assembly electrical connection without a separate bus bar. The bent tab configuration reduces package volume, shortens the current path, and accommodates positional tolerances between stacked assemblies while maintaining reliable electrical continuity.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Create an abstract for a rechargeable battery module design using flat cell bodies, electrode tabs protruding from the cells, spacers between the tabs, and bent distal tab portions connecting neighboring assemblies.
counterfactuals.output: A rechargeable battery module includes a plurality of flat battery cells arranged in a stacked configuration, each cell having electrode tabs protruding from an edge of a cell body. Spacers are disposed between adjacent electrode tabs to maintain separation, provide insulation or positioning, and support the tabs during assembly. Distal portions of selected electrode tabs are bent toward neighboring cell assemblies and joined to corresponding tabs to form electrical connections between the cells. The bent tab structure enables compact interconnection of adjacent assemblies while reducing module height and improving mechanical stability.
